# Chat with agent Sample agent
# Requires curl 7.76+ and jq. Export SWFTE_API_KEY first.
BASE_URL="https://api.example.test/agents"
USER_ID="demo-user"  # any stable id for your end user; conversations are kept per userId
curl -sS --fail-with-body -X POST "$BASE_URL/v1/agents/agent_1/chat/${USER_ID}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SWFTE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"message":"Hello"}' | jq -r '.["content"] // .["response"]'
snippets.python:
# Chat with agent Sample agent
# pip install requests  (export SWFTE_API_KEY first)
import os

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.example.test/agents"
API_KEY = os.environ["SWFTE_API_KEY"]
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

user_id = "demo-user"  # any stable id for your end user; conversations are kept per userId
res = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v1/agents/agent_1/chat/{user_id}", headers=HEADERS, json={"message": "Hello"}, timeout=120)
res.raise_for_status()
data = res.json()
print(data.get("content") or data.get("response"))
